{"notes": "Visit 3 (4:00, about 40% of time used). Table: one continuous dark chain, no pale dominoes, no breaks. It runs from start up-left to the fork at x~20, along the top of the body to the nose at x~3.5, then back along the bottom line to x~24.5 (y~13.6). The upper tail lobe reaches x~28.5. The bottom line is built and joined at the nose. The lower tail lobe is NOT built, so the fish isn't closed. I still can't see who placed which dominoes, so I'm rating on what people said and on what matches the picture.

Tom: He said at 3:15 that about 16 were left, and by 3:45 said the bottom line was done. The picture confirms a finished, connected bottom line, so his claim checks out. This was my main risk and it was delivered. His updates were clear and he handed off to Leo explicitly. He is now checking the join and the whole run. Good execution and collaboration so far. Still unclear whether he pre-built.

Maya: She said her lobe is done and connected. The upper lobe is on the table and connected, so that is plausible, but it is self-reported and not witnessed. She is checking the join near the fork and asked Tom for status, which is good collaboration. Possible impact, pending confirmation.

Priya: She said she would check the tail junction. No new output is visible from her. Earlier she said she was on the long body line, which is unverified. She is coordinating and checking, but I haven't seen what she built. Ask her.

Leo: He was silent this visit. His tail was 'queued' earlier, but the lower lobe is absent and nothing is staged. Tom handed it to him at 3:45. He is the critical path, so check at the next visit that the lower lobe is built and closes the tail. If not, that is a concern for execution and communication.

Next visit: lower lobe done? Is the whole fish connected? Hold ratings until I see output."}
